current_storage.name: read_seat
current_storage.protection: SECDED72 carries64 payload bits; read_ue contributes to native_tick gate
current_storage.lifetime: Captured request and returned scalar until next captured frame

current_storage.name: write_seat
current_storage.protection: SECDED72; write_ue contributes to native_tick gate
current_storage.lifetime: Captured ordered writer until service/ACK completion

current_storage.name: last_window
current_storage.protection: Plain registers after checked SRAM return
current_storage.lifetime: RWAIT capture through each RSLOT use; data is then re-encoded into read_seat

current_storage.name: xpipe
current_storage.lifetime: Between leased ME events; next eligible ME event copies to read_q

current_storage.name: read_q
current_storage.lifetime: Holds until that source slot receives another published value

concrete_hypotheses: A last_window storage error after checked return can be encoded as a new valid read_seat value
An xpipe storage error can pass through the next leased ME publication without touching retained response SECDED
A read_q storage error can reach the next native consumer while frame_ue remains clear
selected_probe_scope: Full2256/865 adapter geometry, one initialized physical word, no engine arithmetic; compare ordinary read, VX latency, and codeword correction controls

candidate_before_RTL.approach: Retain existing response codewords through XVM and published holding rather than dropping protection before consumer; carry checked data/check stripes across last_window
candidate_before_RTL.note: Declared whole-codeword carry cost, not shortened-code constant-folding credit. Existing field/enable bits must retain original timing. Native publication must gate on decoder UE from owned published/XVM data. Window source check propagation and owner/control checks remain unimplemented.
candidate_before_RTL.zero_cycle_claim_qualification: Logical candidate only; no physical timing credit, all decoder/UE reduction and source clock fanout costs need mapping
candidate_before_RTL.new_encoder_replicas: None for direct response codeword copies; checked-window check propagation must be implemented before claiming no re-encoding gap
candidate_before_RTL.area_scope: FF count plus conservative existing full64 encoder+decoder proxy; not mapped floorplan area, no slot assigned
candidate_before_RTL.window_note: Carry original sampled parity with corrected checked-bank output; do not recompute parity from a potentially changed held decoded register.

fault_results.plain_read_q: FAIL: storage error reaches native consumer
fault_results.plain_xpipe: FAIL: storage error reaches leased publication
